text.description_html:
Acorn GR2BG-D, Decorative 12" x 3-1/2" Cast Iron Register

The 12 x 3-1/2 Cast Iron Grille is made from solid cast iron, which makes it durable. Crafted with care with careful attention to product design, this cast iron register is made with the high caliber craftsmanship that has made Acorn the choice of architects, designers and homeowners throughout the world. This register is designed to fit snugly into heading ducts and comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Also available without screw holes and screws.

Want to control the air flow? Acorn Cast Iron Registers with Louver assemblies

Features of the Matte Black Cast Iron Registers:

  • Material: solid cast iron.
  • Traditional matte black finish.
  • Easy to install.
  • Comes packaged mouthing hardware.

Specifications of the Fancy Iron Registers:

  • Overall Length: 12"
  • Overall Width: 3-1/2"
  • Inner Lip Length: 10"
  • Inner Lip Width: 2-1/4"

Sold Individually.
